frameworkCheck.how: The 46 numbered CED topics (9.1–15.8) were read from the current PDF on AP Central and from College Board's Course at a Glance, and each was matched to the StudySprint topic whose guide section and questions teach it. Before this check, nine CED topics had no guide text or questions (9.5 specific heat, 10.6 capacitors in Unit 10, 14.1 wave pulses, 14.3 boundary behavior and polarization, 14.9 thin-film interference, 15.2 the Bohr model, 15.3 emission and absorption spectra, 15.6 Compton scattering, and fission and fusion in 15.7); review notes and original questions were added for each. The Clarifications and Corrections for Fall 2026 reword one essential knowledge statement in 15.7 (radioactive decay includes a nucleus moving to a lower energy level) and change exam timing (42 multiple-choice questions in 85 minutes; free response in 95 minutes); neither changes a unit or topic.
frameworkCheck.weightsSource: the AP Students course page (“On The Exam”), checked 2026-11-08; the CED's Course at a Glance gives the same ranges
differences: The AP Students page lists capacitance under Unit 11 (“Resistance and capacitance”), while the CED places Topic 10.6 Capacitors in Unit 10 and RC circuits (11.8) in Unit 11. StudySprint keeps capacitors in circuits in Unit 11 and now also covers the Unit 10 material (the uniform field between parallel plates and ΔV = Ed).

The AP Students page's topic list is a summary in different words from the CED's topic titles (for example “Vector and scalar fields” and “Forces review”, which are not CED topic titles). Both lists are recorded and both are build-checked.
